cards.questionText:
FROM: Laurel Flanagan <laurel_f@privatemail.com>

TO: Customer Service <customerservice@broadwayelectronics.com>

SUBJECT: Order 65059697

DATE: May 6

Dear Sir/Madam,

I’m writing with regard to an order (order number 65059697) I made on April 20. I spent more than $1,100, but there were still problems with my order. To begin with, the items arrived more than two weeks after being purchased. In addition, I bought some ink for my printer. I ordered two packs of TR440 black ink but was sent two packs of TRÓ87 black ink. I checked which printers that ink is compatible with, and mine isn’t one. The other problem concerns the Montague P2000 digital camera I purchased, while the camera arrived in fine condition, the user’s manual was not included. I therefore have no idea how to operate my new camera.

I want the missing items sent immediately and further request to know how to return the ink to you. Please do this as soon as possible since I am traveling abroad in five days and would like to take my camera with me. This is the third shipping mistake made by your company in the past seven months, while I enjoy shopping at your online store due to the low prices, I am tired of receiving incorrect items and incomplete orders. If something similar happens again, I will no longer frequent your store.

Regards,

Laurel Flanagan

_____________________________________________________

FROM: Customer Service <customerservice@broadwayelectronics.com>

TO: Laurel Flanagan <laurel_f@privatemail.com>

SUBJECT: RE: Order 65059697

DATE: May 6

Dear Ms. Flanagan,

On behalf of everyone in the Shipping Department at Broadway Electronics, I wholeheartedly apologize for the mistakes we made. I assure you that we will do our utmost to ensure that your orders no longer have any problems. In fact, I will personally pack and ship your orders from now on so that you can be sure to receive every item you buy. Your orders will also be sent by premium express mail at absolutely no cost to you. And the next time you purchase some items from us, please use coupon code BIGSAVINGS to receive 50% off any order of $1,000 or less. I hope these actions will convince you to continue using our services for many years to come.

As for the missing items, the ink has been shipped by courier and will arrive before noon tomorrow. The other item is not in stock at the moment, so I ordered it from the manufacturer. It should get here tomorrow, and we will then send it straight to you. You should therefore receive it before you go on your trip.

If you experience any more problems in the future, please call me directly at (403) 679-5495, and I shall do my best to assist you.

Sincerely,

Carmen Diego

Director, Shipping Department Broadway Electronics

childQuestions.questionText: What is the purpose of the first e-mail?
options: (A) To ask why prices have been rising lately
(B) To acknowledge the receipt of some products
(C) To mention the poor quality of a purchased product
(D) To complain about some missing items
correctOptions: (D) To complain about some missing items
childQuestions.transcript: Based on information "I bought some ink for my printer. I ordered two packs of TR440 black ink but was sent two packs of TRÓ87 black ink.", "The other problem concerns the Montague P2000 digital camera I purchased, while the camera arrived in fine condition, the user’s manual was not included."  => Choose D
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Dựa trên thông tin trong bài: "I bought some ink for my printer. I ordered two packs of TR440 black ink but was sent two packs of TRÓ87 black ink.", "The other problem concerns the Montague P2000 digital camera I purchased, while the camera arrived in fine condition, the user’s manual was not included."

Tạm dịch: "Tôi đã mua một ít mực cho máy in của mình. Tôi đặt mua hai gói mực đen TR440 nhưng được gửi hai gói mực đen TRÓ87.", "Vấn đề còn lại liên quan đến chiếc máy ảnh kỹ thuật số Montague P2000 tôi mua trong khi máy ảnh về đến nơi. tình trạng tốt, không kèm theo hướng dẫn sử dụng."

=> Chọn D

childQuestions.questionText: What does Ms. Flanagan indicate she might do in the future?
options: (A) Tell her friends about the bad service
(C) Request a refund on some of her purchases
(D) Visit a Broadway Electronics offline store
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in "If something similar happens again, I will no longer frequent your store."
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Ta thấy Ms. Flanagan đề cập: "If something similar happens again, I will no longer frequent your store." - nghĩa là "Nếu điều tương tự xảy ra lần nữa, tôi sẽ không thường xuyên đến cửa hàng của bạn nữa."

=> Chọn B

childQuestions.questionText: In the second e-mail, the word “ensure” in paragraph 1, line 2 is closest in meaning to:
childQuestions.transcript:
(A) guarantee: to promise to do something; to promise something will happen

(B) predict: to say that something will happen in the future

(C) admit: to agree, often unwillingly, that something is true

(D) confirm: to state or show that something is definitely true or correct, especially by providing evidence

Based on the meaning => Choose A
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Trong e-mail thứ hai, từ “ensure” ở đoạn 1, dòng 2 có nghĩa gần nhất với:

(A) bảo đảm

(B) dự đoán

(C) thừa nhận

(D) xác nhận

=> chọn A

childQuestions.questionText: Which item did Ms. Diego order from a manufacturer?
options: (D) Montague P2000 digital camera user’s manual
correctOptions: (D) Montague P2000 digital camera user’s manual
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in "The other item is not in stock at the moment, so I ordered it from the manufacturer." . "The other item" here refers to "camera user’s manual" because there are two missing items that Ms. Flanagan mentioned in the first passage which are the ink and the user’s manual.
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Thông tin trong bài "The other item is not in stock at the moment, so I ordered it from the manufacturer." . "The other item" ở đây ám chỉ “sách hướng dẫn sử dụng máy ảnh” vì có hai mục còn thiếu mà cô Flanagan nhắc đến ở đoạn đầu đó là mực và sách hướng dẫn sử dụng.

=> chọn D

childQuestions.questionText: Which issue that Ms. Flanagan wrote about does Ms. Diego NOT respond to in her e-mail?
options: (A) How to stop receiving incorrect items
(B) How to return an item to the company
(C) How to receive the items that were ordered
(D) How to get items more quickly
correctOptions: (B) How to return an item to the company

Dear Mr. Simmons,

I made the travel arrangements you requested for your upcoming trip to the Midwest. I sent a copy of your itinerary to you by e-mail but have included a paper copy along with this letter. If you require any modifications, inform me, and I shall make the necessary arrangements.

Upon arriving in Chicago, please head to the Davis Rentals counter at Terminal 3 to pick up your vehicle. I was able to upgrade you to a luxury sedan for the same price that you normally pay for a midsized vehicle. You need to return the vehicle with a full tank of gas on September 18 to avoid paying any excessive fees.

As for your hotels, you have stayed in all but one of them before. There's a hotel that recently opened in Springfield, and I've heard other clients make complimentary remarks about it. It's newer and cheaper than your normal accommodations at the Welcome Inn, so I thought I would reserve you a room there. If you prefer the Welcome Inn though, I will be glad to make a booking for you there.

I'll send the bill for the airfare, car, and hotels to Ms. Thompson in Accounting like I always do. Have a wonderful trip.

Sincerely,

Ted Lyons

Travel Agent

Jade Travel Agency

childQuestions.questionText: What is Mr. Simmons NOT scheduled to do on his trip?
options: (D) Demonstrate how to use a product
childQuestions.transcript:
"Negotiation at Riverside Tractors" => Eliminate B 

"Meeting at Turner, Inc. Tour new facility" => Eliminate C 

"Product demonstration at MTR, Inc." => Eliminate D
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Thông tin được đề cập trong bài:

+ "Negotiation at Riverside Tractors" => Loại đáp án B

+ "Meeting at Turner, Inc. Tour new facility" => Loại đáp án C

+ "Product demonstration at MTR, Inc." => Loại đáp án D

=> Chọn A

childQuestions.questionText: Where will Mr. Simmons stay on September 17?
childQuestions.transcript: Look at the itinerary, we can see that on September 17, Mr. Simmons will stay at Royal Inn, Ames. => A is correct
childQuestions.explanationVi: Nhìn vào hành trình, chúng ta có thể thấy ngày 17/9 (September 17), ông Simmons sẽ lưu trú tại Royal Inn, Ames. => A đúng

childQuestions.questionText: What does Mr. Lyons send to Mr. Simmons along with the letter?
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in "I sent a copy of your itinerary to you by e-mail but have included a paper copy along with this letter."
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Trong bài đề cập thông tin sau: ""I sent a copy of your itinerary to you by e-mail but have included a paper copy along with this letter." 

=> Chọn D

childQuestions.questionText: What does Mr. Lyons mention about Mr. Simmons’s rental car?
options: (A) It comes with a full tank of gas.
(B) It costs the same as usual.
(D) It can be picked up in Peoria.
correctOptions: (B) It costs the same as usual.
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in "I was able to upgrade you to a luxury sedan for the same price that you normally pay for a midsized vehicle."
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Trong bài đề cập: "I was able to upgrade you to a luxury sedan for the same price that you normally pay for a midsized vehicle."  nghĩa là "Tôi có thể nâng cấp cho bạn lên một chiếc sedan sang trọng với cùng mức giá mà bạn thường trả cho một chiếc xe cỡ trung."

=> chọn B

childQuestions.questionText: What is indicated about the Welcome Inn?
options: (A) It is the newest hotel in Ames.
(B) Its owner also runs the Paradise Hotel.
(D) It costs more than the Traveler’s Inn.
correctOptions: (D) It costs more than the Traveler’s Inn.
childQuestions.transcript: In the second passage, there is information "There's a hotel that recently opened in Springfield, and I've heard other clients make complimentary remarks about it. It's newer and cheaper than your normal accommodations at the Welcome Inn" . Look at the itinerary, we can know that the hotel that recently opened in Springfield is Traveler's Inn. => D is correct
childQuestions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn văn thứ hai, có thông tin "Có một khách sạn mới khai trương ở Springfield và tôi đã nghe những khách hàng khác đưa ra những nhận xét khen ngợi về nó. Nó mới hơn và rẻ hơn so với chỗ ở bình thường của bạn tại Welcome Inn" . Nhìn vào hành trình, chúng ta có thể biết khách sạn mới khai trương ở Springfield chính là Traveler's Inn. => D đúng
